rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in nursing, medicine or allied health targeted to the APRN level of practice in the licensed specialty; at least 30 must be Category I (certificates), the rest may be Category II activities
rules.new_licensee_rule: APRNs not yet licensed for a full two years are not asked about CE at their first online renewal.
rules.alternatives: National certification must be kept current (practice is not permitted on an expired certification; not required for APRNs approved before Jan 1, 1996).
rules.audit_note: CE documents are requested only in an audit (upload, mail, e-mail or fax).

topics.who: Licensees whose scope includes prescribing opioid medication (condition of prescribing)
NPs and CNMs who have not prescribed since their last renewal (or since initial licensure)

rules.legal_basis: Maine State Board of Nursing Rules, Chapter 8; 32 M.R.S. §2210
rules.notes: 50 CEUs per 2-year period per specialty area (content may serve two specialties). 3 hours of opioid-prescribing CE every 2 years under 32 M.R.S. §2210.
